resolvedFindings.RE-101-001: V1 no longer infers current Action from latest/highest Run. Caller/host must provide an exact authoritative current Run reference; CLI reads that exact occurrence and composes Policy only from that selected Run. History ordering remains non-authoritative reporting data.

decisions: Run sequence ordering is durable history order only and MUST NOT create current-Action authority.
Foundation CLI V1 requires an exact caller/host-supplied current Run reference and reads only that exact controlled occurrence.
Terminal selected Run contributes its exact linked context/result to Policy; prepared selected Run contributes no manufactured terminal facts.
listChangeRunHistory remains available for reporting/history but not authoritative current selection.
Automatic Run-currentness/lineage remains a later self-hosting concern and is outside this Change.
